pattern.description: The chat transcript auto-scrolls up inside the fixed agent panel, moving the user's request up and revealing the agent's appointment-confirmation reply below.
pattern.why_premium: The conversation advances with a short eased scroll clipped by the panel, timed to the voiceover, so a real product flow reads as live without cuts.

build_hint.gsap: Overflow-hidden transcript container; gsap.to('.transcript', {y: '-=~190px', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}) moving all bubbles, avatars and timestamps as one group; the new agent bubble sits pre-rendered below the fold.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 170}}), [0, 1], [0, -190]) on the message stack inside an overflow-hidden panel; no overshoot.

notes: Repeat of the e010 scroll beat. Per-line OCR boxes are parts of the moving stack and not listed. b15 marks the vacated old avatar position; the new bottom avatar has no candidate box and is omitted.
